---
title: Basic Pickle Brine
subtitle: My go-to brine for pickling anything
---

This is my simple recipe for pickle brine. I like to use white distilled vinegar but you can use apple cider or mix the two. Make sure it's 5% acidity.

## Ingredients

Qty | Ingredient
-|-
`2.25 c` | Water (preferably filtered)
`0.75 c` | Vinegar, 5% (I prefer distilled white)
`1 Tbsp` | Salt
♥️       | Dill, optional, measure with your heart
♥️       | Garlic, optional, measure with your heart
